data.title: bn-24v: bounded read-only entry status
data.description: Bind status to the shared coordination reader, prioritize unresolved runs and chain errors, and preserve typed recorded transport diagnostics. Review the size and no-effect process witnesses, recorded inventory provenance, and catalog lint.
